entities.name: Melchiorre Cafà
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Melchiorre Cafà was a Maltese Baroque sculptor. Cafà began a promising career in Rome but this was cut short by his premature death following a work accident. He was the older brother of the architect Lorenzo Gafà.
